Sourceress is an AI recruiter that is reinventing how people find jobs. With tailor-made machine learning models, we rigorously define what a company is looking for in a role, identify great candidates, and engage candidates with highly personalized introductions. Our process creates a stream of interested candidates that hiring managers are excited about more than 85% of the time.
Unlike generic recruitment tools, Sourceress builds custom AI models for each company and role, ensuring precise candidate matching.
Automated outreach is crafted to be relevant and personalized, increasing candidate response rates and quality.
Supported by Y Combinator, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and OpenAI researchers, providing credibility and access to cutting-edge AI expertise.
Particularly effective for sourcing engineering, product, and design professionals in competitive B2B markets.
Automates sourcing and engagement to deliver a steady stream of qualified candidates with minimal effort from hiring teams[1][2][4].

Sourceress's investors include Accel, Basis Set Ventures, B Capital Group, Blacktop Capital, G20 Ventures, GreaterGoodSociety, Greylock, Oren Yunger, Obvious Ventures, REMUS Capital, S28 Capital, Sapphire Ventures.
